Dentist Saves Pilot's Life During Emergency Landing

A dentist recounted saving the life of Captain Smit, whose pulse had weakened during an emergency landing. The dentist intervened by moving the pilot's legs. The incident involved a harrowing 45-minute ordeal where the pilot, identified as Captain Machhar in one report, was reportedly close to drowning.
